the IL-23R rs11209026 G/A polymorphism was associated with better survival in patients after allo-SCT.
genetic variants of IL-23R and IL-17A genes are prognostic factors in T cell-depeleted allo-SCT, with a potential role in donor selection.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

genetic variants in IL23/Th17 genes are associated with the clinical outcome of T cell-replete and -depleted allo-SCT, and that the genetic variants in the donor and recipient are associated with different clinical outcomes.
the IL-23R rs11209026 GA and the IL17A rs8193036 T and C alleles are associated with a better and a worse clinical outcome, respectively, in patients undergoing T cell-depleted allo-SCT.
IL-23/IL17 signaling pathway is an important mediator in allo-SCT outcome, and the IL-23R rs11209026 and IL-17A rs8193036 genetic variants could be used as prognostic factors in allo-SCT.

genetic variants in IL-23/IL-17 pathway are associated with clinical outcome in allogeneic T cell-depleted SCT.
genetic variants in IL-23/IL-17 signaling pathway may be important predictors of clinical outcomes in allo-SCT.
